overview: 针对不同形态、感知和控制接口的机器人跨具身操作学习困难，EgoX提出了一种基于语义对齐的跨具身学习框架。该方法通过模块化跨具身Transformer（MXT+）对多种异构演示进行预训练，并引入具身梦境（Embodiment Dreaming）目标预测未来视觉与本体状态，以辅助共享架构学习不同具身的动力学特征。实验表明，该方法在多种物理和模拟机器人任务中显著提升了任务完成进度，特别是在分布外场景中展现出更强的泛化性能。

highlights.text: EgoX框架通过具身梦境目标促使共享Transformer模块学习不同机器人的动力学特性，有效提升了跨具身学习的效率。
highlights.evidence: A training-only embodiment-dreaming objective predicts latent representations of future visual and proprioceptive states, encouraging the shared trunk to model each embodiment's dynamics.

highlights.text: 预训练显著提升了机器人在多项任务中的表现，尤其是在面对分布外条件时优势更加明显。
highlights.evidence: Across 13 task-embodiment pairs spanning five tasks and six robot embodiments, including five physical robots and one simulated humanoid, cross-embodiment pretraining raises MXT+'s average normalized task progress from 0.63 to 0.80 over training from scratch. The gains are particularly pronounced under out-of-distribution conditions, where average task progress increases from 0.53 to 0.77.
